aggressive_definition: Aggressive prostate cancer was defined as advanced-stage or high-grade cancer or prostate cancer with PSA at diagnosis over 20 ng/mL.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Moreover, 1770 cancer cases were characterized as aggressive if they were recorded as advanced stage or high-grade cancer or had PSA value at diagnosis over 20 ng/mL.
study_design: Prospective cohort nutrient-wide association study in EPIC with replication in the Netherlands Cohort Study.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: After a mean follow-up time of 14 years for 122,998 men in EPIC, 5916 incident cases of total prostate cancer were identified.
reason: The study evaluated incident total prostate cancer and explicitly analyzed incident disease by stage, grade, fatality, and an aggressive composite endpoint. The supplied estimate pertains to the EPIC aggressive endpoint.
